user.title: Proxmox Reboot Update
user.description: Select the real Proxmox reboot button. The integration creates its own webhook for the reboot-required state.

webhook.title: Proxmox webhook
webhook.description:
Configure the Proxmox status script to POST to:

`{webhook_url}`

The JSON body must be `{"required": true}` or `{"required": false}`. Submit to finish setup.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Proxmox Reboot Update
reconfigure.description:
Current webhook URL:

`{webhook_url}`

You can also change the Proxmox reboot button.

abort.setup_error: Setup state was lost. Please start setup again.

state.reboot_warning: Proxmox was updated automatically. A host reboot is required. Running virtual machines and containers are shut down in an orderly manner. The host and services running on it may be unavailable for several minutes.
